decoder.buildStatus: inferred schema version; not independently verified game client build

policy.matching: Exact reviewed picker aliases only; no generated name substitution. Only consulted when ordinary catalogue lookup is unknown.
policy.identity: Literal IDs from pinned balanced Infobox Item templates establish cache identity. NPC and Recipe IDs never count. Raw cache names may be charged/colour/stage variants or a recorded Wiki redirect.
policy.membership: Every selected Wiki ID must exist as a named non-template cache item, have an explicit boolean Wiki members field, agree with its raw cache flag, and agree with all selected IDs. A single rejected ID or mixed flag leaves unknown.
limits: Membership does not certify a free acquisition method or quest/activity availability.
Pseudoentities and historical variants without explicit current matching IDs remain unknown.
